headline: Bitcoin and Markets React as U.S. Midterm Election Results Unfold
summary: Bitcoin briefly dropped to $75,700 as early U.S. midterm returns pointed to Democrats taking both chambers of Congress. Stock futures and the dollar slid while Treasuries rallied.
why: U.S. congressional elections determine the legislative balance of power, influencing federal spending, tax policy, and regulatory agendas that affect broader financial markets and cryptocurrencies.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin prices fell amid market reaction to shifting political control in Congress.
